column7: auditverify.Verify keyed HMAC with the operator checkpoint key, and a non-empty current or previous key shorter than MinKEKLen panicked under GODEBUG=fips140=only ("crypto/hmac: use of keys shorter than 112 bits ..."). Under fips140.Enforced() Verify now calls checkCheckpointKeyLens first and returns an error wrapping ErrCheckpointKeyTooShort that names MinKEKLen; verify-audit maps it to exit 3 and restore treats it as fatal. TestCheckCheckpointKeyLens_NotEnforcedUnchanged pins default mode. Red (fips140=only, TestVerify_UnderFIPS140Only_ShortCheckpointKeyIsUsageError, skips in default CI) at 5d80e2cfc: Verify panicked. FIPS-TAILS-2 item 4.
